$comment: Provenance: bundled SPICE model library index for circsim, MIT. Every model file referenced here carries its own 'Provenance:' header and was written in-house from datasheet parameters (no vendor model text); the discrete BJT, diode, TVS and LED cards are derived from datasheet operating points by scripts/fit-model-cards.mjs and checked against known third-party library cards by library-fingerprint.test.ts. PinMap node positions are 1-based and refer to the device's terminal order: diode/LED = 'anode cathode' (1=anode, 2=cathode); BJT = 'collector base emitter' (1=C, 2=B, 3=E); VDMOS = 'drain gate source' (1=D, 2=G, 3=S). Pad numbers come from the KiCad footprint. KiCad-official diode footprints (D_*) put pad-1 = cathode, and the pinMaps keys encode that. JLC/EasyEDA-origin diode footprints (JLC lib prefix or bare dimension-pattern names like SMC_L7.1-W6.2-LS8.1) carry NO polarity convention: on the led_lantern rev B board pad 1 is the anode on one of four such diodes and the cathode on the other three, so no footprint-name key can know. selectPinMap therefore never matches those names against pinMaps keys; it returns the KiCad-convention defaultPinMap with a pinmap-unverified polarity warning, and only the attached schematic's A/K pin names (or a Model Doctor override) make the polarity known.

JLC/EasyEDA-origin names (which the generic pattern also matches) are intercepted in selectPinMap before any key is tried and come back pinmap-unverified, because their pad-1 polarity varies by part (led_lantern rev B: D7 SMC pad 1 = anode, but the SMA and SOD-123 diodes are cathode on pad 1).

entries.$comment: SIMPLIFIED idle/off stub V1 (subckt terminals vin intvcc tg1 bg1 tg2 bg2 gnd): behavioral 5V INTVCC LDO + 100k pulldowns holding all four external gate pins low — no switching, no charging (bench a CC/CV source on the output rail instead; see power-ic.lib). normalizeMpn does NOT strip ADI's #TRPBF ordering suffix, so the full board value is listed as an alias. Pad numbers are the JLC QFN-38 footprint's, verified from the routed board nets (pad7=VIN_CHG, pad10=INTVCC, pad1=TG1, pad37=BG1, pad31=TG2, pad33=BG2, pad3=GND) — they differ from the ADI datasheet pin numbering. entries.$comment: SIMPLIFIED DC-AVERAGED constant-current sink (subckt terminals vin set sw ctrl gnd): smooth tanh servo holds v(vin,set) at the 100mV mean sense threshold so Iled~=100mV/Rs; CTRL dimming is a linear v/2.5 approximation with a smooth <0.2V off gate; no switching ripple (see power-ic.lib). entries.$comment: CD4000-series hex inverting Schmitt trigger, pin-compatible with the 74HC14. FIXED-SWING CAVEAT: outputs are modeled at the logic4000.json family constant of 12 V regardless of the actual rail (dac_bridge out_high is per-family; real part runs 3-18 V) — same accepted limitation as the 74HC family's 5 V. Schmitt threshold band 4.8/7.2 V (40%/60% of 12 V) via adc_bridge — in-band input yields an undefined mid-rail output (measured 6 V), not held state. MPN/value matching only — a U + 14-pin fallback would collide with the nine 74HC fallback rules (the LM339/CD4011 lesson).
entries.provenance: XSPICE behavioral CD40106 hex inverting Schmitt trigger written for circsim from datasheet pinout; hysteresis via adc_bridge in_low/in_high band at the fixed 12 V family rail, MIT.

entries.$comment: CD4000-series quad 2-input NAND. CRITICAL: the CD4011 pinout is NOT the 74HC00 pinout — outputs are on pins 3, 4, 10, 11 (74HC00 has 3, 6, 8, 11). entries.provenance: XSPICE behavioral CD4011 quad NAND written for circsim from datasheet pinout + typical tpd (d_nand) at the fixed 12 V family rail, MIT.
